# Furniture Hub Ayodhya

> Handcrafted solid wood and affordable engineered wood furniture from Ayodhya, delivered to your doorstep anywhere in India.

Furniture Hub Ayodhya is a furniture brand based in Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh, India. We specialize in handcrafted solid wood furniture (Sheesham, Teak, Mango Wood, Rosewood) and affordable engineered wood furniture. We deliver pan-India and accept orders via WhatsApp.
